scenario: A recruiter has unsent Ask text, encounters stale evidence-review authority whose terminal notice may fail to persist, and must recover without lost work, obsolete retries, false success, or an automatic send.
frozen_evidence: /tmp/talent-signal-v11-release.xcresult: unsigned generic iOS Release build passed

review_plan.reason: The correction changes interruption recovery and preservation of recruiter work.
The correction changes terminal evidence-authority and rollback semantics.
The correction changes composer continuity, focus intent, and rendered recovery branches.
Truthful recovery and preserved recruiter work affect timely, dignified candidate follow-through.
The artifact does not assess, rank, score, or predict a candidate.

findings.criterion: Interruption recovery and direct transition evidence
findings.observation: The V10 implementation defects are closed in hash-matched source and deterministic unit tests, but V11 does not directly show delayed close/reopen, kill/relaunch, nonempty-draft activation, or terminal-save-failure behavior on the rendered shipping surface.
findings.evidence: The store guards active and transient-terminal keys, the current-evidence handler preserves the draft and focuses without sending, and 100/100 units pass; runtime-evidence.json lists the corresponding rendered transitions as missing.
findings.user_impact: A lifecycle wiring error, unexpected focus change, duplicate request, or misleading recovery control could still cost recruiter work even though the store invariants are correct.
findings.recommendation: Freeze direct UI journeys with composer bytes, focus, visible controls, operation key, and backend request count.
findings.verification: Nonempty text remains byte-identical and unsent; close/reopen has one live request and no reconcile; terminal-save failure offers only the current-evidence path; relaunch shows one protected recovery path and no synthetic success.

strengths: All four V11 source hashes and the referenced correction/baseline hashes match.
The V10 draft veto, terminal-save-failure finding, superseded-to-pending finding, and same-session duplicate-recovery concern are resolved at source/unit confidence.
The change retains the quiet V9 recruiter wedge and adds no external-effect authority.
missing_evidence: Rendered draft, delayed close/reopen, terminal-save-failure, kill/relaunch, and real stale-authority transitions with request counts.
Complete AX5, physical assistive technology, production Apple/microphone, deployment, and field outcomes.
open_questions: Do all shipping Ask presentation paths retain the same account-scoped AgentSessionStore across dismissal and reopening?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action
strengths: All four V11 source hashes, correction references, V9 runtime/manifest, screenshots, and relevant authority-source hashes match.
The failed-superseded-save finding is resolved at source/unit confidence: rollback retains a transient account-session terminal key that blocks claim, pending transition, and ordinary mutation.
Persisted superseded state is terminal, no false-applied path is visible, and exact canonical response validation remains required before applied state.

The obsolete-key control is absent for effective terminality; current-evidence Ask preserves the draft, requires explicit Send, keeps old answers stale, and creates no contact/calendar/notification write.
missing_evidence: Rendered terminal-save failure, delayed close/reopen, kill/relaunch, and real stale-authority iOS transitions.
Dedicated executed assertions for every normal mutation after both persisted and transient supersession.
Revoked, expired, deleted, and deactivated same-key retry runtime; complete physical, production, deletion, field, and evaluator-reliability evidence.
open_questions: Will the next frozen journey exercise both successful and failed terminal persistence while recording UI state and request counts?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.criterion: State completeness, accessibility, and transition proof
findings.observation: V11 closes the draft and terminal-state defects in source and deterministic units, but none of the new branches is frozen as a rendered transition or complete accessibility path.
findings.evidence: The final unit bundle passes 100/100; the V9 UI manifest contains no V11 pending, transient-terminal, superseded, or draft-preservation transition and its AX5 image covers only initial Ask.
findings.user_impact: The model can be correct while the real sheet lifecycle, focus target, control visibility, reading order, or long terminal notice fails during interruption or assistive use.
findings.recommendation: Freeze delayed close/reopen, terminal-save-failure, kill/relaunch, stale-authority, and draft journeys on the smallest supported iPhone, then repeat the terminal path at AX5 with physical VoiceOver and Switch Control.
findings.verification: Each transition renders the documented control state and request count; candidate, source, state, warning, and fresh-Ask semantics remain visible, reachable, and announced in order.

strengths: The V10 active draft-overwrite veto is resolved at source/unit confidence: nonempty text is returned unchanged, blank text is seeded, focus moves, and Send is not invoked.
Failed terminal persistence is fail-closed for the current store and persisted/transient supersession blocks pending, claim, and ordinary mutation.
Effective terminality hides reconciliation, exposes a 44-point fresh-Ask action with a nonretry accessibility hint, and does not rely on color alone.
The V9 visual baseline remains calm, scoped, evidence-led, and free of candidate-worth ranking.
missing_evidence: Rendered live-owner, draft, transient-terminal, persisted-terminal, relaunch, and real stale-authority transitions.
Complete smallest-iPhone AX5 and physical VoiceOver/Switch Control paths.
Production Apple/microphone, deployment, and field proof.
open_questions: Would the session-bounded notice be clearer in assistive output if it said until the app is closed?

reviews.lens: human connection, trust, agency, communication, collaboration

findings.observation: The V10 veto and terminal findings are closed in source/unit evidence, but no rendered transition proves that candidate-protective recovery is visible, focused, and free of obsolete review requests on-device.
findings.evidence: The policy preserves or seeds the draft and focuses without sending; the store blocks persisted/transient superseded keys; the card uses session-bounded copy and current-evidence Ask; the frozen artifact limits closure to source, unit, and Release proof.
findings.user_impact: The design protects recruiter attention and reduces delayed candidate follow-through, but rendering, focus, accessibility, and request timing remain unobserved.
findings.recommendation: Freeze the smallest-device transition matrix with exact draft readback, accessibility focus, explicit-send boundary, and request counts; validate candidate-facing outcomes separately.
findings.verification: Draft bytes and zero automatic sends are observed; terminal failure shows no reconciliation; relaunch and stale authority produce the documented safe states.

strengths: All V11 and referenced frozen hashes match.
The draft veto, failed-terminal-persistence finding, and superseded-to-pending finding are resolved at source/unit confidence with no active candidate-experience veto.
The recovery language distinguishes current authority, failed local persistence, session scope, stale answers, and a fresh Ask without false reassurance or an automatic send.
missing_evidence: Rendered draft, terminal-save-failure, stale-authority, close/reopen, and relaunch transitions.
Actual candidate communication, response commitment, delay update, closure, consent response, and candidate perception.
Complete accessibility, production Apple/microphone, deployment, and field outcomes.
open_questions: After relaunch loses the session tombstone by design, will reconciliation copy clearly communicate that it is checking canonical authority?

top_findings.reason: No V11 rendered path proves draft continuity, sheet lifecycle, transient terminal presentation, real stale authority, focus, or request counts.
top_findings.next_step: Freeze the transition matrix on the smallest supported iPhone, including AX5, then exercise physical VoiceOver and Switch Control.
top_findings.verification: All branches render the documented state, preserve text, avoid automatic sends and obsolete retries, and remain reachable and announced in order.

top_findings.reason: The shared source guard blocks all normal terminal mutations, but the executed tests do not separately attempt applied, failed, and unknown updates against both persisted and transient supersession.
top_findings.next_step: Add deterministic assertions for every normal mutation in both terminal representations.
top_findings.verification: Every attempt returns false or throws, preserves the entire operation, emits no external effect, and leaves the effective UI terminal.

top_findings.reason: Simulator and source evidence do not prove Apple authorization, physical microphone/accessibility behavior, production reliability, or timely recruiter/candidate outcomes.
top_findings.next_step: Complete the authorized physical/production matrix and structured recruiter/candidate field observation.
top_findings.verification: Observed task completion, recovery, communication, consent, and deletion behavior meet the frozen acceptance criteria without candidate harm.

agreements: The V10 active draft-overwrite veto and terminal-state high findings are resolved at source/unit confidence.
No reviewer issued a V11 veto, and no old operation can appear applied or be retried through the documented current-session terminal path.
The current-evidence action preserves nonempty work, seeds only blank input, focuses without sending, and adds no external-effect authority.
Direct transitions, complete physical accessibility, production authorization, and field outcomes remain missing and cannot be inferred from passing units or a Release build.

veto_resolution.veto: V10 active: the recommended superseded-authority action can silently overwrite and persist over an existing Ask draft.
veto_resolution.resolution: The current-evidence policy returns a nonempty draft unchanged, seeds only empty or whitespace input, and the action focuses without sending.
veto_resolution.evidence: Hash-matched RelationshipAskView.swift and RelationshipArchiveTests.swift; final unit bundle passes 100/100. Direct rendered transition remains missing.

adjudication.rationale: V11 removes the V10 block and has no active veto, so the frozen local correction may continue. It is not release-ready or a 99-point claim because rendered transitions, complete accessibility, physical/production authorization, deletion boundaries, and field outcomes remain unproven. Specialist scores stay attached to their own rubrics and are not averaged.

next_tests.evidence_required: Executed pending, applied, failed, unknown, and claim attempts against both terminal representations.
next_tests.pass_condition: Every forbidden mutation is rejected and the complete operation remains unchanged.

next_tests.evidence_required: Recordings/transcripts, production receipts, deletion lineage, and structured recruiter/candidate observation.
